  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION

  BTech VII Semester - Make up Examination - December -2024  
  Data Structures and Algorithms [ECE-4070]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Differentiate between Program and Algorithm. Discuss the specifications of an  
  algorithm.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Differentiate between Space complexity and Time complexity.                                   (3)  
  C)      Represent and discuss the significance of Sparse matrix transpose.                            (3)  
  2)           Illustrate and explain the postfix expression evaluation in stacks.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Discuss the implementation of Queues using arrays.                                            (3)  
  C)      With an example code, explain the deletion operation at the given position for a Singly  
  linked list.                                                                                  (3)  
  
  3)           Illustrate and explain the methods for deletion of a node in case of a Binary Search tree.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Enlist tree traversal operations and explain any one with suitable example.                   (3)  
  C)      Elaborate the terminologies used in AVL tree with proper definitions.                         (3)  
  4)           With an illustration, explain the Incidence matrix to represent graphs.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Suggest an algorithm for Depth First Search(DFS) method.                                      (3)  
  C)      Discuss the steps of Insertion sort algorithm.                                                (3)  
  5)           Suggest an algorithm for Quick sort highlighting the significance of the same.                (4)
